preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
The maximum path length to consider is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The maximum path weight to consider is between 0 and 109, inclusive.
Each edge connects a vertex (i + 1) to a previous vertex pi with a non-negative weight wi.
The weight of each edge is between 0 and 104, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == number of pairs (v, u) such that v < u and there exists a path of length at most l and weight at most w between v and u
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of pairs of vertices that are close according to the given conditions.
